extracted.intended_audience: electric cooperatives, policymakers, congressional staff, and federal agency officials
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and policy priorities for modernizing federal permitting, regulatory implementation, and related programs to help electric cooperatives maintain reliable, affordable service and deploy clean energy. The page lists recommended legislative/administrative reforms and program-design principles co-ops want policymakers and agencies to follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish firm parameters for environmental reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish firm parameters for environmental reviews, including how long the reviews should take.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation from John Carr (Dairyland) as a priority for lawmakers to reform permitting processes to enable the energy transition while ensuring reliability and affordability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote applicant involvement while preserving agency authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote greater involvement by co-ops and other permit applicants in the process while still giving federal agencies the final word.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage more meaningful participation by permit applicants so their perspectives are considered during reviews, but retain agency decision-making authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faster reviews for minimal-impact projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure faster, more efficient reviews for projects that clearly have minimal environmental impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create expedited pathways or categorical exclusions for low-impact projects to reduce delays and costs that impede deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit unnecessary litigation of NEPA reviews with time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Limit unnecessary litigation of NEPA reviews. Put time limits on how long someone can wait before filing a lawsuit against a federal agency after the agency grants a permit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set statutory or procedural deadlines for post-permit legal challenges to reduce multi-year project delays caused by litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support BUILDER Act permitting reforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Support the BUILDER Act, which contains recommendations such as limiting review lengths, encouraging greater involvement by permit applicants, and creating deadlines for filing lawsuits after permits have been granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative backing for specific permitting-reform measures; page cites co-op leaders urging Congress to endorse the bill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement IRA provisions for co-ops (direct-pay and USDA program)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing NRECA’s two priority provisions in the Inflation Reduction Act: direct-pay energy tax credits and the $9.7 billion U.S. Department of Agriculture program to assist co-ops with the energy transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should structure program rules to allow co-ops to utilize direct-pay credits and USDA grant/loan funds effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shape agency funding announcements for infrastructure programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Shaping agency funding opportunity announcements for co-op programs included in the bipartisan infrastructure law (rural broadband, EV chargers, grid resiliency and modernization, physical security and cybersecurity, and clean energy programs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure FOAs are accessible to co-ops and account for co-ops’ needs so they can successfully apply and use funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect co-op access to affordable, reliable power amid EPA regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Protecting co-op access to an affordable, reliable power supply as the Environmental Protection Agency looks to regulate greenhouse gas emissions and air pollutants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulatory actions should not jeopardize co-ops’ ability to secure affordable and reliable generation resources for their members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure sound transmission policy during FERC reforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring sound transmission policy as the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission contemplates first-in-a-decade transmission reform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate transmission rules and planning that facilitate necessary build-out to support electrification and renewable integration while recognizing co-op needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Defense Production Act authority to ease supply chain shortages
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that the Department of Energy uses its presidentially directed Defense Production Act authority appropriately to ease supply chain shortages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target DPA actions to relieve bottlenecks affecting co-ops’ ability to procure equipment and complete projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimize DHS reporting requirements for co-ops
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that any new cybersecurity or physical security reporting requirements by the Department of Homeland Security are optimized for co-ops to enhance their security posture and improve their ability to protect against, detect and respond to—or recover from—threats to the electric system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design reporting obligations so they are practicable for smaller utilities and bolster rather than hinder resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modernize environmental permitting to give certainty
rubrics_metrics.description: Modernizing environmental permitting: the existing processes take too long, are too expensive and are an impediment to co-ops’ ability to meet future energy needs. They need to be modernized to give more certainty in the energy transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reform should reduce time and cost of reviews, increase predictability, and enable timely deployment of generation and transmission infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamline vegetation-management permitting and BLM/Forest Service guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with co-ops to prepare for and respond to catastrophic wildfires. Co-ops that want to do vegetation management are running into inconsistent guidance from the Bureau of Land Management and the Forest Service; we need to work with the agencies to streamline the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate federal land-management agencies to provide consistent, efficient guidance and permitting for vegetation work that protects lines and reduces wildfire risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure accuracy of FCC broadband maps
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with co-ops to ensure that the broadband maps produced by the Federal Communications Commission are done correctly to provide the best picture of where broadband is and isn’t available across the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurate mapping is necessary to target broadband funding and deployment; agencies should correct pre-production drafts and data issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educate Congress with Co-op 101 sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Hold Co-op 101 sessions to meet new members of Congress and educate them about electric cooperatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outreach and education help lawmakers understand co-ops’ unique structure and policy needs so legislation and implementation fit rural realities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shape the Farm Bill to support co-op-relevant USDA programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the new five-year Farm Bill supports USDA programs used by co-ops (rural development financing, home energy efficiency program, clean energy deployment financing) and consider rewriting and improving USDA ReConnect broadband program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reauthorize and streamline USDA programs to reduce bureaucracy and increase co-ops’ access to funds and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep program design simple and flexible
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep it simple. Keep it flexible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRECA advice to agencies administering programs (e.g., the $9.7 billion USDA program): program rules should account for the diversity of co-op circumstances and avoid unnecessary complexity that prevents access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize reliability and affordability in energy policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Policymakers should approach national energy policy with a core focus on affordability and reliability; ensuring sufficient resources to meet tomorrow’s energy needs is paramount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid regulatory or policy choices that prioritize speed of transition over practicality and risk causing resource shortfalls and higher costs for consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage pace of plant retirements and include extreme-weather scenarios in planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage the pace of fossil-fuel-powered plant retirements to ensure adequate supply; include extreme weather scenarios in resource and system planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt planning standards that account for peak demand and extreme events (per NERC recommendations) to avoid shortages and rolling blackouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain diverse generation mix and reliable baseload during transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Respond to consumer desire for a diverse energy mix while maintaining reliable baseload power as part of a lower-carbon future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Co-ops should pursue diverse technologies (renewables, gas, hydro, bio-gas, etc.) and policymakers should enable options that preserve reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility performance evaluation areas (J.D. Power metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utility performance was measured in six areas: power quality and reliability; price; billing and payment; communications; corporate citizenship; customer care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improving communication about financial assistance and energy-efficiency programs can significantly boost overall customer satisfaction; co-ops should balance reliability and affordability rather than prioritizing lowest price alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expedite NEPA reviews tied to RUS loans and critical infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Co-ops must undergo NEPA reviews for permits and for vegetation removal on federal land and when applying for Rural Utilities Service loans; lengthy NEPA reviews and litigation delay critical infrastructure projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate for expedited, predictable NEPA processes for projects tied to RUS funding and essential reliability upgrades to avoid multi-year delays and litigation impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure federal programs account for co-op diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure government programs and funding to account for 'the diversity of circumstances of co-ops across the country.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program rules and implementation should be adaptable so small, rural, or fast-growing co-ops can participate and benefit without undue administrative burden.
